query: Check the historical adjusted EBITDA values between the IPO prospectus and the Annual report. Do they match?
expected_answer: The data in the documents provided allows us to compare historical adjusted EBITDA data for 2019 (previous years are not documented in the yearly report and 2020 is partially forecasted in the prospectus). For 2019, there are slight variations in adjusted EBITDA values reported. It can be found reported as 307,941 NOKK, or as 307,549 NOKK or as 307.5 NOKM or as 307,548 NOKK. So the values don't fully match, though they are all within 307.5 and 307.9 NOKM.
output:
Based on the retriever agent’s detailed extraction and reconciliation summaries, I conclude the following:

Short answer
- The historical Adjusted EBITDA values in the Prospectus and the Annual Report do not contain material contradictions once you account for units (NOK 1,000 vs NOK million), rounding, and the difference between interim (prospectus) and audited full-year figures (annual report). Where the same period is reported in both documents the numbers match within rounding or presentational differences. For example: Prospectus 2019 Adjusted EBITDA 307.5 mn (reported also as 307,548 in NOK 1,000) matches Annual Report 2019 Adjusted EBITDA 307,549/307,941 (differences of 1–392 in thousands appear to be rounding/aggregation or table segmentation but are immaterial).  

Detailed findings and explanation
1) Units and scope
- Both documents use the same Adjusted EBITDA definition (EBITDA adjusted for M&A costs, restructuring, share-based compensation and other one-off/non-recurring items) and both explicitly state these are APMs (non‑IFRS).  
- The Prospectus presents some tables in NOK million and others in NOK 1,000; the Annual Report primarily uses NOK 1,000. When normalized to the same unit, the reported Adjusted EBITDA figures line up.

2) Periods compared
- Prospectus reports six-months to 30 June 2020, LTM to 30 June 2020, and full historical years 2017–2019.  
- Annual Report reports full year 2020 and historical years (2019 etc.). Where the Prospectus reports an interim/LTM number (e.g., LTM 356.1 mn to 30 Jun 2020) and the Annual Report reports full year 2020 (390.8 mn), these are different metrics by design and should not be expected to match.

3) Numeric comparisons (examples)
- 2019 (full year): Prospectus: 307.5 mn (shown as 307,548 in NOK 1,000). Annual Report: 307,549 / 307,941 (two tables show 307,549 and 307,941). The differences (1–392k NOK) are immaterial and consistent with rounding/aggregation or minor segmentation differences between tables.
- Six months ended 30 Jun 2020: Prospectus Adjusted EBITDA = 182.6 mn (shown in NOK 1,000 as 182,645). Annual Report shows six-month/segment breakdowns that reconcile to the same interim totals when normalized to the same units (observed tiny rounding differences only).
- Full year 2020: Annual Report Adjusted EBITDA = 390,841/390,842 (NOK 1,000). Prospectus LTM to 30 Jun 2020 was 356.1 mn — these differ because LTM to 30 Jun 2020 excludes the second half of 2020; Annual Report FY2020 includes the full year and audited adjustments.

4) Reasons for any differences
- Unit/format differences (NOK million vs NOK 1,000) and rounding/aggregation produce very small numeric deltas.  
- Prospectus contains interim and unaudited figures (e.g., six months to 30 June 2020, “as adjusted” items) whereas the Annual Report contains audited full-year results for 2020; interim/prospectus figures are explicitly noted as unaudited and preliminary, so differences arising from subsequent audit adjustments or later events are expected.  
- The Annual Report’s “Non-recurring items” grouping and the Prospectus’ separate breakdowns (M&A costs, restructuring, share-based comp) align conceptually; small differences in how individual components are grouped in tables can create tiny mismatches in subtotals.

5) Materiality
- All observed discrepancies are very small relative to the totals (typically within rounding of a few hundred thousand NOK or a single unit in a table), or are explained by differences in the reporting period (interim/LTM vs full-year). I therefore assess that there are no material mismatches between Prospectus and Annual Report Adjusted EBITDA amounts after normalizing units and considering period differences.

6) Recommendation / next steps (optional)
If you want absolute certainty (e.g., for audit or regulatory purposes), I can:  
- Retrieve the full Prospectus and the full Annual Report PDFs and produce a side-by-side normalized table (all figures converted to NOK million) for each year with every reconciliation line and source page references, or  
- Produce a short memo summarizing where any rounding/aggregation differences occur and extracting the exact cell-level values that differ.  

Which of those would you prefer? If you want the full-document extraction and side-by-side table, confirm and I will fetch the full PDFs and produce the normalized comparison.
